episodeTitle.en: How to win in the AI era: Ship weekly, embrace technical debt, ruthlessly cut scope, and more
episodeTitle.zh: 如何在AI时代胜出：每周发布产品、接受技术债务、无情地缩减范围等

guestBioOfficial.en: Gaurav Misra is the co-founder and CEO of Captions, an AI-powered video creation company and one of the most successful consumer AI products in the world today. Previously he was a product leader at Snap, where he created the design engineering function and spent years helping develop features used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. With a background in both engineering and design, Gaurav brings a unique cross-functional perspective to product development. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 加瓦尔·米斯拉是Captions的联合创始人兼CEO，Captions是一家AI驱动的视频创作公司，也是当今全球最成功的消费级AI产品之一。此前，他曾在Snap担任产品负责人，创建了设计工程部门，并花费数年时间帮助开发了全球数亿用户使用的功能。凭借工程和设计背景，加瓦尔为产品开发带来了独特的跨职能视角。你将学到：

title.en: How to win in the AI era: Ship weekly, embrace technical debt, ruthlessly cut scope, and more
title.zh: 如何在AI时代胜出：每周发布产品、接受技术债务、无情地缩减范围等

summary.en: Gaurav walks through how a modern AI-native startup actually operates: every engineer ships a marketable product or feature every single week, they deliberately take on technical debt to move faster than big companies, and they run a hidden 'secret roadmap' alongside the public one because user-requested features are rarely a competitive edge. He reflects on what Snap taught him about building consumer/social apps—running with no PMs and letting designers run the show—and grapples with a world where AI-generated video is indistinguishable from real. The episode is packed with operating lessons for anyone building on top of AI.
summary.zh: Gaurav 拆解了一家现代 AI 原生创业公司的真实运作方式：每位工程师每周都要交付一个可上市的产品或功能；他们刻意承担技术债务，以比大公司更快的速度前进；并在公开路线图之外另设一条“秘密路线图”，因为用户提出的功能很少构成竞争优势。他回顾了 Snap 教给他的关于打造消费/社交应用的经验——不设 PM、由设计师主导，也直面了“AI 视频真假难辨”的世界。这期节目充满面向所有在 AI 之上构建产品者的运营经验。
